name: grue-resurrection
description: M4 Phase 2 scenario (epic #163, death and recovery): death by grue, `y`, resurrection with the possessions scattered. Promotes the discovery run F12 (GAMEPLAY-FAILURE-INVENTORY.md; "patched" there is the game's own word: JIGS-UP asks "Do you want me to try to patch you?"), extended so the hero carries something to scatter. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0). Into the kitchen; take the sack and the bottle; the sword from the living room (the lamp stays there); `up` into the dark attic; `north`: WALK's <PROB 75> for an unlit room (77rooms.mud:1063) succeeds under this clock and seed and there is no north exit, so JIGS-UP (77rooms.mud:870) "Oh, no!  You walked into the slavering fangs of a lurking grue.": SCORE-UPD -10, DEATHS 1, the question (YES/NO, 77defs.mud:431, a READSTRING entry whose prompt is the question, not `>`), `y`: the lamp (in the living room) is put first in the hero's possessions, GOTO FORE1, EGYPT-FLAG set, ROB-ADV finds no valuable, the four possessions go one each to the first rooms of RANDOM-LIST (77dung.mud:1476: living room, kitchen, clearing, forest). Then `look`, `inventory`, and a walk that sees the scattered sack (forest), sword (kitchen) and lamp (living room), and `score`. Prefix 11 (input ends at the question) is a native QUIT: the empty answer leaves the stale `n` of `north` in INBUF, which refuses (FINISH -> RECORD -> QUIT). Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/GRUE-RESURRECTION-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
